text: [“] Do not let your⁺ hearts be troubled. You⁺ believe in God (Believe in God); believe in Me as well.
In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you⁺ that I am going there to prepare a place for you⁺?
And if I go and prepare a place for you⁺, I will come back and welcome you⁺ into My presence, so that you⁺ also may be where I am.
You⁺ know the way to the place where I am going [And where I go you know, and the way you know.].
“Lord {Kyrie}, said Thomas (twin), “we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?
Jesus (YHWH saves) answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father {Patera} except through Me.
If you⁺ had known Me, you⁺ would know My Father {Patera} as well. From now on you⁺ do know Him and have seen Him.
Philip (friend of horses) said to Him, “Lord {Kyrie}, show us the Father {Patera}, and that will be enough for us.

Jesus (YHWH saves) replied, “Philip (friend of horses), I have been with you⁺ all this time, and still you do not know Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father {Patera}. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father {Patēr} is in Me? The words {rhēmata} I say to you⁺, I do not speak on My own. Instead, it is the Father dwelling in Me, performing His works (acts).
Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father {Patēr} is in Me—or at least believe on account of the works (acts) themselves.
Truly, truly, I tell you⁺, whoever believes in Me will also do the works (acts) that I am doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father {Patera}.
And I will do whatever you⁺ ask in My name, so that the Father {Patēr} may be glorified in the Son.
If you⁺ ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it.
If you⁺ love {agapate} Me, you⁺ will keep (If you love Me, keep) My commandments.
And I will ask the Father {Patera}, and He will give you⁺ another Advocate (Comforter) to be with you⁺ forever \to the age/—
the Spirit {Pneuma} of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you⁺ do know Him, for He abides with you⁺ and will be in you⁺ [and is in you].
I will not leave you⁺ as orphans; I will come to you⁺.
In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you⁺ will see Me. Because I live, you⁺ also will live.
On that day you⁺ will know that I am in My Father, and you⁺ are in Me, and I am in you⁺.
Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves {agapōn} Me. The one who loves Me will be loved {agapēthēsetai} by My Father, and I will love {agapēsō} him and reveal Myself to him.
Judas (praise) (not Iscariot) asked Him, “Lord {Kyrie}, why are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?
Jesus (YHWH saves) replied, “If anyone loves {agapa} Me, he will keep My word. My Father {Patēr} will love {agapēsei} him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
Whoever does not love {agapōn} Me does not keep My words. The word that you⁺ hear is not My own, but it is from the Father who sent Me.
All this I have spoken to you⁺ while I am still with you⁺.
But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit {Hagion Pneuma}, whom the Father {Patēr} will send in My name, will teach {didaxei} you⁺ all things and will remind you⁺ of everything I have told you⁺.
Peace I leave with you⁺; My peace I give to you⁺. I do not give to you⁺ as the world gives. Do not let your⁺ hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
You⁺ heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you⁺. If you⁺ loved {ēgapate} Me, you⁺ would rejoice that I am going to the Father {Patera}, because the Father {Patēr} is greater than I.
And now I have told you⁺ before it happens, so that when it does happen, you⁺ will believe.
I will not speak with you⁺ much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.
But I do exactly what the Father {Patēr} has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love {agapō} the Father {Patera}. Get up! Let us go on from here.
